title: The Third Cup: Change Never Sleeps
why_read: A narrative-style, metaphor-driven piece about change using the I Ching as a framing device, with no real technical engineering content.
analysis: This is a short fictional vignette set in a café, using a conversation about the I Ching to muse philosophically about the inevitability of change in IT work. It reads as creative writing rather than a technical explainer, article, or tutorial. There's no code, architecture, or concrete engineering lesson delivered in the excerpt provided.
